reviews.comment: She will never provide clear instructions or explanations on anything. Basically a self-taught course except it's impossible because you can't do the projects with the textbook alone. Honestly, the word to describe her is "mean" because she treats you like an inadequate human being when received questions not up to her expectations.

reviews.comment: She gives almost no feedback. The grading seems completely arbitrary and little to no rubric is given for any assignment. Communication skills are clearly lacking. All of this makes it extremely hard to get anything out of this class.

Took her for capstone. Provided zero rubrics and no guidance. Gave us points off for "lack of professionalism" when we did great. When we asked how to improve our project, she said she did not know and did not expect much from us anyways. Blamed us for not asking questions, when she would not answer our questions. Unresponsive, terrible prof.

Dr. Murphy does not teach anything. You will have to read all chapters on your own and come to the class to give quizzes. Once quizzes are done, professor will supplement the reading with examples. This style of teaching was a pain for grad students conducting research as you will have to spend a lot of time studying for this class alone.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES
